meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意文本自动生成无脸解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把文章或笔记快速变成解说视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into a faceless explainer video automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn articles or notes into explainer videos

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把你的文章、笔记或主题变成一段“无脸”解说视频——画面全是自动生成的文字、图表和抽象图形，不需要你提供任何网站或实拍素材。
howto.when: 当你给 Claude 一段文字（比如一篇科普文章或操作指南），并说“做成解说视频”时触发。它适合做知识讲解、概念拆解、教程或清单类视频。

say.text: 把这篇关于复利的文章做成一个3分钟的解说视频。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤生成故事板、配音和动画帧。

say.text: 用这段笔记做一个无脸解说视频，主题是“如何做番茄炒蛋”。
say.note: Claude 会重新组织内容，设计视觉和旁白。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude turns your article, notes, or topic into a faceless explainer video—all visuals (typography, diagrams, abstract graphics) are auto-generated, no website or footage needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you give Claude a text (e.g., a science article or how-to guide) and ask to make an explainer video. Best for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, tutorials, or listicles.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a 3-minute explainer video.
say_en.note: Claude will generate storyboard, voiceover, and animation frames step by step.

say_en.text: Make a faceless explainer video from these notes on how to cook scrambled eggs with tomatoes.
say_en.note: Claude will reorganize content and design visuals and narration.
